name: Regen Projects
about_text: Regen Projects is a contemporary art gallery on Santa Monica Boulevard in Los Angeles. The gallery represents an international roster of established and emerging artists working across painting, sculpture, photography, film, and installation. Its program has become known for supporting artists who engage with conceptual, social, and political concerns, spanning generations from pioneers of Conceptual and Minimal art to younger figures working in figuration and abstraction today. Regen Projects regularly organizes solo exhibitions for its artists in Los Angeles and participates in major international art fairs, while its artists are frequently included in biennials, museum surveys, and public commissions worldwide. The gallery also represents several artist estates, continuing the legacies of important late-twentieth-century figures.

triage.site_notes: The site is organised with a single Artists roster index feeding into per-artist sub-pages (biography, bibliography, exhibitions, press), a combined Exhibitions section split into current and a single long past-exhibitions archive list, and separate News, Art Fairs, Publications, and Contact/About sections; individual exhibition and publication detail pages are largely redundant given the comprehensive archive list, so most were left as 'other'.
